thread:
mira: Heads-up — product wants to run a per-tenant quantized-model rollout (Q1 pilot). Goal: lower unit cost for high-volume customers while preserving latency SLOs. Need cross-team alignment on sequencing, risk controls, and launch criteria. Who owns what?

alex: I can own the runtime changes (quant profiles + autotune). Need infra capacity for mixed-precision pools. Estimated dev effort 2 sprints.

tonY: @alex FYI infra needs a clear traffic migration plan. We can't mix quantized and fp32 on same node set without perf regressions. Suggest separate node pool + feature flag.

sarah_p: Security checklist: model artifacts must be validated for integrity and provenance, and we need a short privacy review for per-tenant model variants. Also add KMS key rotation note.

rachael: Product asks for an opt-in pilot for 3 customers, can start with low-risk workloads (non-sensitive). Launch criteria: 5% token cost savings, <10ms median tail increase, zero customer-facing correctness regression on our eval set.

dan: Platform/SDK changes: we need a route-level config to pin quant profile per-tenant + a fallback policy when perf regresses. ETA 1 sprint if owners clear requirements.

infra-bot: capacity-snapshot
```
region: us-west-2
available_quant_nodes: 24
available_fp32_nodes: 120
max_mixed_capacity: 20%
```

alex: Proposed sequence: 1) infra creates quant node pool + feature flag; 2) runtime adds quant profiles + dynamic kernel selection; 3) platform exposes per-tenant pinning and fallback; 4) pilot with canary traffic (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Need security sign-off after step 2.

rachael: Product alignment: we'll prepare customer consent language and curate prompt/eval set. Also want a rollback SLA: 30 min rollback target if we see quality regression.

sarah_p: OK. I'll do a risk assessment doc and quick checklist. Need to validate artifact signing and KMS policy. Aim to complete within 7 business days.

tonY: Ops note — prewarming: quant nodes need different preheat profiles. We should schedule a prewarm run during internal staging to measure cold-start tail. Ops can allocate a 48-hour window.

alex: Could we add an automated perf gate that rolls back if P99 increases > 20%? That would help with the rollback SLA.

rachael: +1 to perf gate. Also want an adoption metric: % of tokens served quantized per tenant and per-route. We'll track weekly.

dan: I'll prototype the route config + telemetry events this week. Will share a short spec with required metrics.

mira: Great — owners: Alex (runtime), Tony (infra/ops), Dan (platform/SDK), Sarah (security), Rachael (product). Blockers: infra pool creation, security artifact flow, and telemetry hooks. Next sync Thursday 11am PT to sign off canary window.

alex: I'll post a minimal rollout playbook before Thursday (canary steps + rollback commands).

rachael: I'll message the 3 pilot customers and get consent + sample prompts.

mira: Thanks everyone. Let's keep the thread for updates; drop quick notes here (no long docs). :thumbsup:
